rules.text: Decision traversal starts at the requested report section and follows link parentage toward the root. Links are read-only during check.
Any explicit block for the subject at the requested section or any ancestor wins over every grant in that chain.
If the chain contains no explicit block, a grant at the requested section or any ancestor permits access. The closest grant supplies exact reason allow:<scope>.
A suspended subject is denied before rule traversal, even when grants exist. resume restores normal evaluation.
If no block and no grant is found in the chain, check returns DENY with exact reason default-deny.
Trace is append-only and copied on read. Configuration mutations emit link/grant/block/suspend/resume; each check emits exactly permit or reject after resolution.

callableSurface.ownership: The report permission owns parent links, subject-scope rules, disabled state and trace. Callers supply immutable subject/scope strings.

transitions: parent/rule mutation changes future evaluation only
decision does not mutate rules or parent links

eventOrdering: configuration events are emitted after their mutation
disabled/suspended rejection is resolved before parent traversal
deny precedence is resolved before allow result
permit/reject is the final event for one decision
abortErrorPrecedence: There is no abort/error surface. suspended has first decision precedence, then explicit block anywhere in the chain, then closest grant, then default deny.

identityMutation.inputs: subject and scope strings are read only
identityMutation.rules: decide/check never mutates parent links or rules
identityMutation.trace: trace returns a new array with new event objects
